resources.string:
Badminton Trainer version 0.9 - Sensolic Official 


Brand new features 

Players - now players can be added to the app 
Finally the heart concept has found its way into the app. Brand new player profile views can be opened. Some interesting stats are available as well. 

New points system - this is the basis for the leaderboard 
We spent a lot of time creating a points system ensuring both, justice and fun. The new system calculates the earned point according to your enemy's points. This allows a competitive and fair system at once. 


Other changes: 

Added new settings options 
Default match type - now you can select a match type which will be opened on startup of match registration. This is the first step in personalizing the app. 

Better storage system 
Player data can now be stored. As well there have been various improvements and bug fixes. 

New ID formats 
Players and matches now have a new ID format. The IDs are defined by a specific algorithm. This should reduce misunderstandings and disputes about similar or easy IDs. 

Improved match registration 
The match registration has got a huge update. Users aren't able to write invalid player names anymore. The registration became more solid, easier and faster. 

New app version format 
The app version format has been changed to a 2 compound expression. Now app versions will have the format "xx.xx" 

Improved match view 
Player profiles can now be opened by clicking on the player icon in match view. 

Better navigation 
For better navigation there are several back buttons in the left upper corners. They are very intuitive and easy to understand. 
The changelog can be closed by a button now. 
A new dialog pops out if user wants to exit the app by pressing the back button. This avoids unexpected closing of the app. 


Total time spent on this update: 
- around 27 hours - 


 ~Sensolic TM~
